item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Lady Gaga (Stefani Germanotta) on Boiling Point 2005
item.description:
I don't care what quality you can find for me.

It used to be on YT in full, but all I get now is a few little clips. It's where Stefani (Gaga) orders a salad, and it keeps getting taken away, and the winner of the game is when the unknowing contestant doesn't "boil over" for 14 minutes or something like that...

Here's a better description:

Boiling Point


Boiling Point was a show on MTV back in 2005 that put random people in stressful situations to see if they could last a set amount of time, depending on the situation, without getting mad. Completion of this task earned the player $100. In Season 3, episode 22, Stefani Germanotta, aka Lady Gaga, became one of the show's contestants. The "BP" was set for 14 minutes, but Stefani lasted only 12 minutes and 36 seconds.

...It was SO funny, and as a Monster the same age as Gaga, I can remember those days of trash tv.

Thank you!
